hero: A clearer lens on an uncertain prediction.
intro: What does a model learn from 5,110 observational records—and what should we refuse to conclude? Explore the data, inspect the trade-offs, and try the real pipeline.
question: The research question
questionBody: Can a reproducible classifier recover recorded stroke labels while balancing missed positives against false alarms? This is an observational classification task, with no validated future prediction horizon.
safety: Educational research demo only. No diagnosis, screening advice, clinical decision support, or validated personal future-stroke probability. Do not use this score to make health decisions.
limits: Selection bias and a confidential original sampling source limit external validity. Class imbalance, false positives, false negatives, sparse categories, and uncertain calibration remain. Feature importance does not establish causation.
auditBody: The reference notebook reported age up to 188 and mean glucose 9,622.81. The original CSV has age up to 82 and mean glucose 106.15. We rebuilt from publisher version 1; no blanket division, clipping, or row removal. Historical notebook scores are not our benchmarks.
explorerIntro: Aggregate descriptions of the complete source dataset, computed after the experiment policy was frozen. Associations describe this sample; they do not prove causes.
missingBody: BMI is imputed with the development-fold median. Unknown smoking remains a category; the single Other gender record is retained.
binHelp: Bins include their lower bound and exclude their upper bound; the final bin includes both. Missing BMI is excluded only from its histogram, not from training.
labIntro: Three-fold stratified development CV compares ten bounded configurations. Thresholds maximize precision with OOF recall ≥ 75%; eligible models need precision ≥ 10%. Among models within 0.01 of the best average precision, candidate order favors simplicity.
calibrationBody: Five quantile bins compare mean score with observed label frequency. Lower Brier is better, but compare against the majority baseline. No post-hoc calibration was fitted; class weighting can distort score calibration.
holdoutBody: The selected complete pipeline was fitted on development rows only. Holdout predictions were computed after selection. OOF results used for selection can be optimistic; final holdout results are a separate estimate, not external validation.
thresholdHelp: This exploration changes the chart readout only. The deployed decision threshold stays frozen.
apHelp: AP summarizes the precision–recall ranking (not trapezoidal PR area). Recall = TP/(TP+FN); precision = TP/(TP+FP). Accuracy alone can reward always predicting the majority class.
simIntro: Use fictional profiles to inspect model behavior. Inputs stay within observed source ranges; valid ranges do not guarantee that a combination is represented in training.
synthetic: These are fictional inputs, not observed patient records or medical risk categories.
error: Could not reach the service. Check that FastAPI is running, then retry.
validation: Check the highlighted input values and observed ranges. BMI may be left empty.
unitHelp: Glucose uses unaltered CSV values. mg/dL is a convention assumed in the reference report, not a confirmed unit in the publisher dictionary. Do not enter mmol/L values or convert clinical measurements here.
resultHelp: This score describes the model's response to an input. It is not a validated estimate of your future stroke probability. Either classification may be wrong.
imputed: BMI was replaced with the fitted development median.
rare: Other gender has one source record; group performance cannot be established.
unusual: This age/category combination may be poorly represented. Interpret it cautiously.
globalBody: Mean decrease in validation-fold AP after shuffling each raw feature, over three development folds and five repeats. Correlated features can share or mask importance. Negative values are retained; spread is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
localBody: For Logistic Regression only: transformed input × fitted coefficient, grouped by raw feature. Intercept + contributions = log-odds; sigmoid(log-odds) = score. These are model terms, not causal effects or risk changes from an intervention.
localEmpty: Submit a profile to inspect its local decomposition if the selected model is linear.
globalOnly: The selected model is nonlinear. This demo provides global associations only; it does not invent per-profile contributions.
methodBody: Raw CSV → stratified split → fold-fitted imputation, scaling and one-hot encoding → OOF selection → saved complete pipeline → inference-only API. No database, request-time training, or synthetic API responses.
